purpose: AI-generated realism and OCR/vision stress tranche for LabelVerify. These assets complement deterministic SVG labels; their prompt-declared fields must be treated as intended truth until visual transcription/audit confirms exact in-image text.

validationPolicy.benchmarkUse: Use for visual realism/OOD and robustness tests immediately; use for strict field-level accuracy only after manifest visualAudit.status is accepted and extractedTextOverrides are filled where text drift exists.
validationPolicy.textCaveat: AI image generators can alter small text. Prompt-declared fields are not automatically exact ground truth.
validationPolicy.auditMethod: Manual visual audit by Codex plus four read-only sub-agents split across image chunks 0001-0013, 0014-0026, 0027-0039, 0040-0050.
validationPolicy.importantGroundTruthRule: expectedFields contains the visually corrected field data to use for tests. promptDeclaredFields is retained only for provenance and should not be treated as exact ground truth.
